help.title: Help & contact
help.q1: Is Rattil wa Salli really free?
help.a1: Yes. Rattil wa Salli has no ads, no subscriptions and no purchases, and it will stay that way.
help.a2: The Quran text, tafsir, prayer times, qibla, adhkar, tasbih and your bookmarks all work offline. Recitations stream from the internet unless you save the surahs first (Settings → Listen offline).
help.q3: Why do the prayer times differ from my mosque?
help.a3: Mosques use different calculation methods and add a few minutes for caution. Choose your country's method and Asr school in the prayer settings, and adjust each prayer by minutes if needed.
help.q4: How do I change the reciter or the speed?
help.a4: In Settings → Recitation, or from the player itself while a recitation is playing.
help.a5: On this device only: bookmarks, khatma, worship tracker and settings never leave it unless you turn on account sync yourself.
help.q6: Why did the adhan not sound on the website?
help.a6: A website can only sound the adhan while one of its pages is open, and the browser must be allowed to show notifications. The phone app sounds it even when closed.
help.q7: I found a mistake in a text. What should I do?
help.a7: Use "Report a mistake" under the dhikr, or write to us below. Religious texts come from published sources and go through a review.
help.contactPending: The contact address will be added soon.
